name: labs/accelerationconsortium__opentrons-ot2
title: Opentrons OT-2 motion controller (OT2MotionController)
intro: Opentrons OT-2 motion controller (OT2MotionController), adapted from accelerationconsortium/opentrons-ot2. It reads `simulating`, `position`, `firmware_version`, `serial_number` and 6 more; sets `button_light` and `rail_lights`; runs `cartesian_pose`, `move_axes`, `home_all`, `aspirate` and 3 more. `cartesian_pose`: move the tool centre point to a Cartesian position and orientation in a named frame. The endpoint solves inverse kinematics; an unreachable target is rejected before motion. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
